domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 系统由稳定运动进入不稳定运动时对应的速度界限。
usage_overview: 用于判别车辆运行稳定性的速度界限。在所述铁路货车模型中，通过观察初始扰动后的轮对横移是否衰减，以横移不再衰减时的运行速度识别失稳临界速度。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P013.title: Development of a railway wagon-track interaction model: case studies on excited tracks
P013.authors: L Xu, X Chen, X Li, X He
P013.label: Xu等（2018）

complete_examples.text: With this study, extensive contributions in figuring out the critical speed of instability, limits and localizations of track irregularities over derailment accidents are presented by effectively integrating the dynamic simulation model, the track irregularity probabilistic model and time-frequency analysis method.

In the current paper, following the principle that complex system should be constructed by energy method, a reliable approach to model the railway wagon-track interactions is presented using methodologies of energy-variational principle and dynamic equilibrium equations, through which the modelling procedures will be significantly simplified, and then an effective model used for simulating realistic and representative track irregularity excitations is briefly presented, finally, model validations and extensive applications in critical speed of instability and derailment analysis will be illustrated.
